description:
This PR fixes #176 and contains parts of #160 

Adds pointer interaction support to:
UI:
- VM List cells
- VM View toolbar buttons

VM:
- Cursor movement
- Auto hiding iPadOS cursor when inside VM display area

Missing:
- Configuration views, any other views not mentioned

comments.body: Are you sure this is the right check? From a cursory glance it seems like you're using the wrong receiver…also, can you not just use `@selector`?
If not the ~above~below, `return 0 <= pos.x && pos.x <= scaledSize.width && 0 <= pos.y && pos.y <= scaledSize.height`?
That didn't work because the rects that this function builds aren't sized properly. I didn't dive too deep into it.
It's a hack, and has been removed!
It's part of UIKit, I don't know if one can weak link only parts of it.
I think you'd add something like `-Wl,-U,_OBJC_CLASS_$_UIPointerInteraction` to the build flags.
